mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail under a Waxing Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is moving forward with a new Public Works and Utilities facility to handle our population growth, while crews are also currently wrapping up phase two of the Mark Drive reconstruction project.
We have a full calendar starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and tomorrow at Paddy Mac's, followed by various trivia nights and yoga classes through next week.
On November 2, Verona Police responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was taken into custody for battery and disorderly conduct.
Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, and you will definitely want to try today's delicious flavor of the day, Really Reese's.
